source.name: Kiel Institute for the World Economy - Ukraine Support Tracker (Trebesch et al., Kiel Working Paper 2218)

definitions.allocated: Kiel 'allocations': aid delivered or specified for delivery (contracts, packages, disbursements)
definitions.committed: Kiel 'commitments': official pledges/declarations incl. multi-year frameworks; total_committed >= allocated in most cases; pledged_not_delivered = committed - allocated (can be negative where allocations exceed tracked pledges)
definitions.loans_face_value: Kiel Fig 8 financial allocations: 'Loan' + 'ERA Loan' at face value (guarantees and swap lines excluded)
definitions.by_year: Sum of monthly bilateral allocations by calendar year from sheet 'Allocations per Month' (2026 = Jan-Aug)
definitions.certainty: A = reported/itemised in official sources compiled by Kiel; B = >25% of value estimated by Kiel from weapon price lists, or secondary-source estimate

USA.notes: USA total_allocated includes the US ERA loan (USD 20bn = EUR 18.34bn) coded as a financial allocation (Oct 2024). Almost no new US allocations after Jan 2025. ERA loan (G7 Extraordinary Revenue Acceleration, repaid from immobilised Russian asset profits): committed 18.3413, allocated 18.3413 EUR bn (included in financial_allocated and loans_face_value). Financial allocations by type (EUR bn): loan 0.0, grant 28.9559, guarantee 0.0, ERA loan 18.3413, central-bank swap line 0.0. Guarantees are NOT counted in loans_face_value. Military in-kind values partly estimated by Kiel from price lists: 0.0 bn of allocations (0%) are 'calculated with prices'. refugees_hosted = UNHCR refugees from Ukraine in this country, end-2025 (Refugee Data Finder API).

DEU.notes: EU member: figures are BILATERAL only and EXCLUDE the member's imputed share of EU-institution aid (Kiel imputed share: allocated 22.7017, committed 43.9808; bilateral+EU share allocated 53.5425, committed 98.2323). Do not add EU_INST on top if using the incl-share figures (double count). Kiel Policy Brief 217 (Oct 2026): of the EUR 100.9bn the German government reports, Kiel classifies ~EUR 31-41.7bn as bilateral aid to Ukraine; EUR 22.0bn are future military commitments; EU share adds EUR 22.7bn. Financial allocations by type (EUR bn): loan 0.3, grant 1.3625, guarantee 0.0, ERA loan 0.0, central-bank swap line 0.0. Guarantees are NOT counted in loans_face_value. Military in-kind values partly estimated by Kiel from price lists: 12.068 bn of allocations (39%) are 'calculated with prices'. refugee_cost = EUR 34.6bn federal spending on Ukrainian refugees in Germany (27.45 Buergergeld via BMAS + 7.15 BMF support to Laender/municipalities), German government overview as of June 2026, reported in Kiel Policy Brief 217 (Oct 2026). Federal level only; excludes Laender/municipal own spending. A press report citing Kiel UST data to Aug 2025 gave EUR 36.5bn (different scope/date). refugees_hosted = UNHCR refugees from Ukraine in this country, end-2025 (Refugee Data Finder API).

aggregates.note: Kiel Country Summary 'Total' row: sum over all tracked donors incl. EU institutions (EUR bn), 24 Jan 2022 - 31 Aug 2026.

notes: All aid figures are nominal EUR bn from Kiel UST Release 31 workbook sheets 'Country Summary (€)', 'Fig 8. Financial Aid by type', 'Allocations per Month' and 'Bilateral Assistance, MAIN DATA' (ERA rows, price-estimated share).
Kiel timeframe starts 24 Jan 2022 (not 24 Feb); pre-invasion aid is small.

EU member figures are bilateral only; EU-level aid is in EU_INST. Kiel's imputed member shares of EU aid are given per member (eu_share_*) - use EITHER bilateral+EU_INST OR the incl-share totals, never both.

Kiel excludes refugee-hosting costs in donor countries, private donations and international organisations. Release 31 workbook contains no per-country refugee cost estimates; refugee_cost is filled only where another source was found (DEU, POL, CZE).
refugees_hosted = UNHCR end-2025 refugees from Ukraine by country of asylum (api.unhcr.org population endpoint, year=2025).
Countries not in Kiel's sample (MDA, GEO, ISR, ARE, SAU, KAZ, ARM, AZE, BRA, MEX) have null aid fields.
Kiel warns each release supersedes previous ones; do not compare across releases.
